library(pheatmap)
breaks <- c(0, 0.05, 0.95, 1)
colors <- c("deepskyblue", "gray80", "blue2")  # <0.05, 0.05-0.95, >0.95
get_color <- function(x) {
  if (x < 0.05) return("deepskyblue")
  else if (x > 0.95) return("blue2")
  else return("gray90")}

result_PIV4A #Fraction of Pr(rateA>rateB|data).The matrix represents the fraction that a row element is greater than a column element. 
##             rate_N      rate_P     rate_M     rate_F     rate_HN    rate_L
## rate_N  0.00000000 0.004666148 0.20808799 0.28041329 0.006443728 0.9171203
## rate_P  0.99533385 0.000000000 0.95511610 0.98133541 0.537829130 1.0000000
## rate_M  0.79191201 0.044883902 0.00000000 0.61793134 0.057771359 0.9895567
## rate_F  0.71958671 0.018664593 0.38206866 0.00000000 0.024886124 0.9870014
## rate_HN 0.99355627 0.462170870 0.94222864 0.97511388 0.000000000 1.0000000
## rate_L  0.08287968 0.000000000 0.01044328 0.01299856 0.000000000 0.0000000
col_mat <- matrix(apply(result_PIV4A, c(1, 2), get_color), nrow = nrow(result_PIV4A))
result_PIV4A_map <- pheatmap(result_PIV4A,
         color = colors,
         breaks = breaks,
         cluster_rows = FALSE,
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         cellwidth = 10,
         cellheight = 10,
         border_color = "white")

library(coda) #does the 95HPD
## Warning: package 'coda' was built under R version 4.2.3
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
## Warning: package 'dplyr' was built under R version 4.2.3
## 
## Attaching package: 'dplyr'
## The following objects are masked from 'package:stats':
## 
##     filter, lag
## The following objects are masked from 'package:base':
## 
##     intersect, setdiff, setequal, union
library(tidyr)
## Warning: package 'tidyr' was built under R version 4.2.3
library(patchwork) #combine plots

virus_list <- list(
  PIV4A = PIV4A_genes,
  PIV4B = PIV4B_genes,
  PIV2  = PIV2_genes,
  MuV   = MuV_genes
)

genes <- c("rate_N","rate_P", "rate_M", "rate_F", "rate_HN", "rate_L")

# all combinations of pair of viruses
virus_pairs <- combn(names(virus_list), 2, simplify = FALSE)

#for each gene and pair of viruses:
for (gene in genes) {
  cat("\n--- Gene:", gene, "---\n")
  plot_list <- list()
  for (pair in virus_pairs) {
    v1 <- pair[1]
    v2 <- pair[2]
    
    rate1 <- virus_list[[v1]][[gene]]
    rate2 <- virus_list[[v2]][[gene]]
    
    #confirm the same column lenght, or truncate to shortest
    n <- min(length(rate1), length(rate2))
    rate1 <- rate1[1:n]
    rate2 <- rate2[1:n]
    
    # ratio y 95%HPD
    ratio <- rate1 / rate2
    hpd <- HPDinterval(as.mcmc(ratio), prob = 0.95)

    cat(sprintf("  %s vs %s:\n", v1, v2))
    cat(sprintf("    95%% HPD of %s/%s: [%.4f, %.4f]\n", v1, v2, hpd[1], hpd[2]))
    
    # plot
    plot_viruses_rates <- sprintf("Gene %s: %s / %s", gene, v1, v2)
    p <- ggplot(data.frame(ratio = ratio), aes(x = ratio)) +
      geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, fill = "skyblue", color="black") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
      labs(title = plot_viruses_rates,
           x = sprintf("Rate ratio: %s / %s", v1, v2),
           y = "Frequency") +
      theme_minimal() + xlim(0,3)
    
    plot_list[[paste0(v1, "_vs_", v2)]] <- p
  }
  # Combinar todos los plots para ese gen
  combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 2)
  print(combined_plot)
}

library(ggplot2)
library(coda)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)

for (gene in genes) {
  cat("\n--- Gene:", gene, "---\n")
  plot_list <- list()
  
  comparison_data <- data.frame()

  for (pair in virus_pairs) {
    v1 <- pair[1]
    v2 <- pair[2]
    
    rate1 <- virus_list[[v1]][[gene]]
    rate2 <- virus_list[[v2]][[gene]]
    
    n <- min(length(rate1), length(rate2))
    rate1 <- rate1[1:n]
    rate2 <- rate2[1:n]
    
    ratio <- rate1 / rate2
    hpd <- HPDinterval(as.mcmc(ratio), prob = 0.95)
    median_ratio <- median(ratio)
    
    cat(sprintf("  %s vs %s:\n", v1, v2))
    cat(sprintf("    95%% HPD of %s/%s: [%.4f, %.4f], median: %.4f\n", v1, v2, hpd[1], hpd[2], median_ratio))
    
    comparison_label <- sprintf("%s / %s", v1, v2)
    
    comparison_data <- rbind(comparison_data, data.frame(
      comparison = comparison_label,
      lower = hpd[1],
      upper = hpd[2],
      center = median_ratio
    ))
  }
    comparison_data <- comparison_data %>%
    mutate(comparison = factor(comparison, levels = rev(comparison)))
    
    plot_comparison <- ggplot(comparison_data, aes(x = comparison, y = center, ymin = lower, ymax = upper)) +
      geom_pointrange(color = "steelblue", size = 0.7) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(title = paste("Gene", gene),
           y = "Rate ratio (median and 95% HPD)",
           x = NULL) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 10)  + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 3))
    
print(plot_comparison)

ggsave(
  filename = paste0("forestplot_", gene, ".svg"),
  plot = plot_comparison,
  width = 3, 
  height = 1.5,   
  dpi = 300 
)

}
